mapper.select:
select (row_number() over()) as rownum ,csdb_id as id ,split_part(filename,'.',1) as name ,filesize as size ,reg_date as date from csdb_master where 1=1
and csdb_id = #{csdbId}
mapper.insert: insert into csdb_master ( csdb_id, filename, filesize, reg_date ) values ( #{csdb_id}, #{filename}, #{filesize}, NOW() )
mapper.delete: delete from csdb_master where csdb_id = ( select csdb_id from csdb_master where replace(filename,'.zip','') = #{csdb_id} )
mapper.select: select dmc_id from csdb_data_modules where csdb_id = ( select csdb_id from csdb_master cm where 1=1 and cm.filename like concat('%', #{csdb_name}, '%') ) and dmc_id like concat('PMC','%') order by dmc_id

SELECT json_build_object( 'dmc', dmc_id,
-- 1. 메타데이터 (row_to_json 대신 json_build_object로 정교한 객체 생성) 'metadata', ( SELECT json_build_object( 'techName', xt.techName, 'infoName', xt.infoName, 'security', xt.security ) FROM XMLTABLE( -- XML 내부 네임스페이스 무시 처리를 위해 local-name() 활용 '//*[local-name()="identAndStatusSection"]' PASSING content COLUMNS techName TEXT PATH './/*[local-name()="techName"]', infoName TEXT PATH './/*[local-name()="infoName"]', security TEXT PATH './/*[local-name()="dmStatus"]/*[local-name()="security"]/@securityClassification' ) xt LIMIT 1 -- 혹시 모를 다중 행 방지 및 스칼라 변환 보장 ),
-- 2. 본문 XML 내용 그대로 문자열 변환 'body_xml', (xpath('//*[local-name()="content"]', content))[1]::text
)::text AS ietm_data FROM csdb_data_modules WHERE replace(dmc_id, '-', '') like concat('%', replace(#{id}, '-', ''), '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO csdb_data_modules ( csdb_id, dmc_id, content, file_path, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{csdb_id}, #{dmcId}, #{xmlContent}::xml, #{filePath}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (csdb_id, dmc_id) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO csdb_icn ( csdb_id, icn_id, filename, content, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{csdb_id}, #{icnId}, #{filename}, #{content}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (csdb_id, icn_id) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, filename = EXCLUDED.filename, updated_at = NOW()
